## Desktop Select `red / blue / both` in the upper-left corner, choose a workspace, and enter a file, directory, or URL target with a Goal. The live canvas shows execution branches; activity, logs, reports, and health views retain the evidence behind the result. - **Independent strategies.** `red` and `blue` use separate analysis policies. `both` lets each strategy plan multiple actions, exchange evidence during execution, and independently check their results before combined verification. - **Concurrent Goals.** Goals and ready actions run concurrently without an application-level count limit. Switching views, tasks, or workspaces does not redirect a running task's output. - **Managed workspaces.** First launch creates a default workspace. Open or create others, import samples, and keep original and working copies separate. - **Goal control.** Goals have no time or token limit by default. Set either limit when needed, stop a run, or add instructions while it is running. Verification results and failed attempts remain in the execution history. - **Knowledge and usability.** Browse defense articles and paired references, switch light/dark themes, and retain unsent drafts, reading positions, and filters during navigation. ### Download and setup The `v2.0.0-beta.1` desktop packages have been withdrawn while desktop and knowledge-base distribution are separated. A replacement package is not yet published. You can [build the current source preview](#build-the-desktop). 1. Install Python 3.11 or newer and make the `python` command available on PATH. Windows also needs the Microsoft Edge WebView2 runtime. 2. Follow the [source build instructions](#build-the-desktop). Keep personal workspaces outside the source directory. 3. Open Settings and configure an OpenAI-compatible chat-completions endpoint and model, then enter a target and objective. SHA256 verification can run locally without a model. Windows x64 is the desktop packaging target. Python and third-party tools such as Ghidra, Frida, and x64dbg are installed separately. macOS/Linux support the source-based CLI/MCP workflow; native desktop packages for those platforms are not currently provided. The installed edition offers Beta and Stable update channels; beta builds select Beta initially. See [application updates](desktop/UPDATES.md). The desktop executes target triage and Python actions without a default tool time limit. MCP tool references in KB articles do not automatically become desktop adapters for debuggers, devices, or hardening tools. Workspace files stay on disk, while model-assisted runs send task context and selected evidence to the endpoint you configure. Python actions run with the current user's permissions. See the [desktop guide](desktop/README.md) for configuration, data handling, and limits. ## Knowledge base and MCP Independent knowledge packs, MCP extensions, and GitHub/ZIP import are described in the [extension design](EXTENSIONS.md). The [authoring skill](tools/skills/create-reverselab-extension/SKILL.md) includes draft templates and an offline ZIP checker; the application importer is planned. The knowledge base covers Web/CTF, Android/APK, Windows/PE, and general topics such as cryptography and protocols. Articles carry `track: red | blue | both`; `both` articles are shared. Related attack and defense articles are linked through index metadata and `defends` references. The current catalog is the source of truth; not every article has a one-to-one counterpart. | Area | Knowledge entry | Tool examples | | --- | --- | --- | | Web / CTF | [Web knowledge](kb/shared/ctf-website/README.md) | `kb_router`, `http_probe`, `run_ctf_tool` | | Android / APK | [APK knowledge](kb/shared/apk-reverse/README.md) | `android_app_baseline`, `android_crypto_unpack_recipe` | | Windows / PE | [PE knowledge](kb/shared/pe-reverse/README.md) | `triage_pe`, `ghidra_headless_analyze`, `sample_full_workup` | | General | [Cross-domain knowledge](kb/shared/general/README.md) | `solve_crypto_from_evidence`, `rizin_*` | CLI/MCP track selection defaults to `blue`; select `red` or `both` explicitly through `REVERSELAB_MODE`, `--track`, or the MCP track tools. Desktop selection is scoped to its Goals and does not rewrite another client's environment. ```sh python scripts/misc/kb_router.py "JWT" --track blue python scripts/misc/desktop_kb.py list --track both ``` ## CLI and AI-agent setup Clone the repository, then use `START_HERE.bat` / `START_HERE.cmd` on Windows or `./START_HERE.sh` on macOS/Linux. These are setup and MCP checks, not the desktop launcher. The reports are written under `reports/misc/`. ```sh git clone https://github.com/LING71671/open-reverselab.git cd open-reverselab ``` Open this directory in your AI client and read [AI-USAGE.md](AI-USAGE.md). The context chain is `CLAUDE.md → AGENTS.md → AI-USAGE.md → boards//AI-USAGE.md`. For guided installation, use the [English](templates/prompts/ai-install.en.md) or [Chinese](templates/prompts/ai-install.zh.md) prompt. MCP clients need `uv` and the dependencies in `tools/skills/mcp/ReverseLabToolsMCP`. ```sh uv sync --project tools/skills/mcp/ReverseLabToolsMCP uv run --project tools/skills/mcp/ReverseLabToolsMCP python scripts/misc/mcp_smoke_check.py --write-report python scripts/misc/lab_healthcheck.py python scripts/misc/ai_toolcheck.py --board misc ``` Install only the tool groups needed for the task. Windows provides `scripts/misc/install_tools.ps1 -CTF`, `-Android`, `-Windows`, and `-Common`; POSIX wrappers are generated by `scripts/misc/bootstrap.sh`. See [START.md](START.md) and [tools/README.md](tools/README.md). ## Build the desktop With Node 22+, pnpm, Python, Rust, and the platform Tauri prerequisites installed: ```sh cd desktop pnpm install --frozen-lockfile pnpm tauri dev # Or create a production executable: pnpm tauri build --no-bundle ``` `pnpm dev` is the browser preview. See [development](desktop/DEV_GUIDE.md), [architecture](desktop/ARCHITECTURE.md), [Agent contracts](desktop/AGENT_SYSTEM.md), [error codes](desktop/ERROR_CODES.md), and [release instructions](RELEASING.md). ## Data and repository layout | Location | Purpose | | --- | --- | | `desktop/` | Desktop UI, queue, execution engine, and Tauri host | | `kb/` | Reusable techniques and defense references | | `scripts/`, `tools/`, `templates/` | Automation, adapters, and templates | | `boards/` | Task routing for external AI clients | | `site/` | Documentation-site source | | Selected workspace's `.reverselab/` | Desktop originals/work copies, Goal records, exports, and reports | | Repository `cases/`, `samples/`, `notes/`, `exports/`, `reports/` | Local CLI analysis artifacts; excluded from publication | Desktop data defaults to `~/.open-reverselab/workspaces/Default`. The host environment snapshot is separate at `~/.open-reverselab/env/env.md`. Neither belongs in a public commit. See [workspace storage](desktop/WORKSPACES.md). ## Contributing and publication Read [Contributing](.github/CONTRIBUTING.md), [Security](SECURITY.md), and [Publication](PUBLICATION.md). Publish general implementations and synthetic examples; keep real targets, samples, credentials, and case evidence private. Before submitting, run `python scripts/misc/public_release_check.py` and the checks relevant to the changed module. Release history is in [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md). --- ## Star History

## 桌面端 在左上角选择 `red / blue / both`，选好工作区，填写文件、目录或 URL 目标和任务内容。实时流程画板展示执行分支，执行记录、日志、报告和健康监控保留结论所依据的证据。 - **策略独立。** red 与 blue 分别维护分析策略，both 中两方均可规划多个动作，在执行中交换证据，各自核验后再核验完整目标。 - **多任务并行。** Goal 与就绪动作支持并行，应用不设置数量上限。切换页面、任务或工作区不会改变后台任务的输出归属。 - **工作区管理。** 首次启动创建默认工作区，也可新建或打开其他目录。导入样本时保留原件，另建工作副本。 - **目标控制。** 默认不设时间或 Token 上限，可按需填写，也可停止运行或中途补充要求。执行历史保留核验结果与失败尝试。 - **知识库与操作体验。** 支持 defense 文档、关联阅读、深浅主题；页面切换时保留未提交草稿、阅读位置和筛选条件。 ### 下载与启动 `v2.0.0-beta.1` 桌面包已撤下，正在调整为桌面端与知识库独立分发，替代安装包尚未发布。目前可[从源码构建预览版](#从源码运行桌面端)。 1. 安装 Python 3.11 或更新版本，确保终端能执行 `python`。Windows 还需要 Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime。 2. 按[源码构建步骤](#从源码运行桌面端)启动，个人工作区放在源码目录之外。 3. 在设置中配置兼容 OpenAI chat-completions 的 API 地址和模型，再填写目标和任务内容。SHA256 核验可直接在本地运行，无需模型。 桌面端以 Windows x64 为打包目标，Python、Ghidra、Frida、x64dbg 等外部工具需另行安装。macOS/Linux 可使用源码形式的 CLI/MCP 工作流，暂未提供桌面安装包。安装版提供“测试版”和“稳定版”更新渠道，beta 构建初始选择测试版渠道，详见[应用更新](desktop/UPDATES.zh-CN.md)。 桌面端执行目标初筛与 Python 动作，默认不设工具时限。知识库中的 MCP 工具名不会自动成为调试器、设备或加固执行适配器。工作区文件保存在本地，模型辅助任务会把任务上下文和所选证据发送到配置的模型端点；Python 动作继承当前用户权限。配置、数据流向和能力范围见[桌面端说明](desktop/README.zh-CN.md)。 ## 知识库与 MCP 独立知识包、MCP 扩展及 GitHub/ZIP 导入方案见[扩展设计](EXTENSIONS.zh-CN.md)。[创建 skill](tools/skills/create-reverselab-extension/SKILL.zh-CN.md) 提供草案模板与离线 ZIP 检查工具，应用导入器仍待开发。 知识库覆盖 Web/CTF、Android/APK、Windows/PE，以及密码学、协议等通用主题。文档用 `track: red | blue | both` 标记所属轨道，其中 `both` 表示共享。攻击与防御文档通过索引元数据和 `defends` 关联；实际目录为准，并非每篇文章都存在一对一对应项。 | 领域 | 知识入口 | 工具示例 | | --- | --- | --- | | Web / CTF | [Web 知识库](kb/shared/ctf-website/README.md) | `kb_router`、`http_probe`、`run_ctf_tool` | | Android / APK | [APK 知识库](kb/shared/apk-reverse/README.md) | `android_app_baseline`、`android_crypto_unpack_recipe` | | Windows / PE | [PE 知识库](kb/shared/pe-reverse/README.md) | `triage_pe`、`ghidra_headless_analyze`、`sample_full_workup` | | 通用 | [跨领域知识库](kb/shared/general/README.md) | `solve_crypto_from_evidence`、`rizin_*` | CLI/MCP 默认使用 `blue`，可通过 `REVERSELAB_MODE`、`--track` 或 MCP 轨道工具显式切换。桌面端的模式属于各自 Goal，不会改写其他客户端的环境变量。 ```sh python scripts/misc/kb_router.py "JWT" --track blue python scripts/misc/desktop_kb.py list --track both ``` ## CLI 与 AI Agent 入门 克隆仓库后，Windows 使用 `START_HERE.bat` / `START_HERE.cmd`，macOS/Linux 使用 `./START_HERE.sh`。这些入口负责环境和 MCP 检查，桌面程序单独启动。检查报告写入 `reports/misc/`。 ```sh git clone https://github.com/LING71671/open-reverselab.git cd open-reverselab ``` 在 AI 客户端打开目录并阅读 [AI-USAGE.md](AI-USAGE.md)。上下文链为 `CLAUDE.md → AGENTS.md → AI-USAGE.md → boards//AI-USAGE.md`。需要 AI 协助安装时使用[中文提示词](templates/prompts/ai-install.zh.md)。MCP 客户端需要 `uv` 和 `tools/skills/mcp/ReverseLabToolsMCP` 中的依赖。 ```sh uv sync --project tools/skills/mcp/ReverseLabToolsMCP uv run --project tools/skills/mcp/ReverseLabToolsMCP python scripts/misc/mcp_smoke_check.py --write-report python scripts/misc/lab_healthcheck.py python scripts/misc/ai_toolcheck.py --board misc ``` 按任务安装工具组。Windows 提供 `scripts/misc/install_tools.ps1 -CTF`、`-Android`、`-Windows`、`-Common`；POSIX wrapper 由 `scripts/misc/bootstrap.sh` 生成。详见 [START.md](START.md) 与 [tools/README.md](tools/README.md)。 ## 从源码运行桌面端 准备 Node 22+、pnpm、Python、Rust 和当前平台的 Tauri 构建依赖： ```sh cd desktop pnpm install --frozen-lockfile pnpm tauri dev # 构建生产程序： pnpm tauri build --no-bundle ``` `pnpm dev` 启动浏览器预览。详见[开发指南](desktop/DEV_GUIDE.zh-CN.md)、[架构图](desktop/ARCHITECTURE.zh-CN.md)、[Agent 契约](desktop/AGENT_SYSTEM.zh-CN.md)、[错误码](desktop/ERROR_CODES.zh-CN.md)和[发布说明](RELEASING.zh-CN.md)。 ## 数据与目录 | 位置 | 用途 | | --- | --- | | `desktop/` | 桌面 UI、队列、执行引擎与 Tauri 宿主 | | `kb/` | 通用技术与防御知识 | | `scripts/`、`tools/`、`templates/` | 自动化脚本、适配器和模板 | | `boards/` | 外部 AI 客户端的任务路由 | | `site/` | 文档站源码 | | 所选工作区的 `.reverselab/` | 桌面样本原件／副本、Goal、输出与报告 | | 仓库内 `cases/`、`samples/`、`notes/`、`exports/`、`reports/` | CLI 本地分析产物，不进入公开发布 | 桌面默认数据目录为 `~/.open-reverselab/workspaces/Default`。本机环境快照另存于 `~/.open-reverselab/env/env.md`；二者都不能提交到公共仓库。备份与迁移见[工作区文档](desktop/WORKSPACES.zh-CN.md)。 ## 参与贡献与发布 请阅读[贡献指南](.github/CONTRIBUTING.md)、[安全策略](SECURITY.md)与[公开边界](PUBLICATION.md)。提交通用实现和合成示例，真实目标、样本、凭据和案例证据留在本地。提交前运行 `python scripts/misc/public_release_check.py` 及所改模块的检查。版本历史见 [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.zh-CN.md)。 --- ##
